raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "configuration 1 load locations and number",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 specifies only the face opposite the fixed face. The initial BVP is delegated to a figure: the prose cites Fig. 1(A,D), while the cantilever caption identifies Fig. 2(A,D). Neither the locations nor the number of loads for configuration 1 is stated. For the alternatives below, take the fixed face as x=0, the loaded face as x=1, and y,z in [0,1].",
      "readings": [
        "One load centered at (1, 1/2, 1/2).",
        "One load at the edge midpoint (1, 1/2, 0).",
        "Two loads at (1, 1/2, 1/4) and (1, 1/2, 3/4)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "spatial footprint and distribution of each load",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 and the Fig. 2 caption do not specify whether the loading is concentrated, distributed along an edge, or applied over a surface patch, nor how a concentrated load is represented on the grid.",
      "readings": [
        "A concentrated force applied at one boundary node.",
        "A uniform line load along a unit-length edge of the opposite face.",
        "Uniform traction over one boundary-voxel face, of area 1/4096.",
        "Uniform traction over a square patch with side length 1/8.",
        "Uniform traction over the entire opposite face."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "configuration 1 force or traction directions",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The configuration 1 load vectors are not described in Sec. 4.1 or its figure caption. Loading the opposite face does not determine whether the load is normal, tangential, or oblique.",
      "readings": [
        "Normal loading in the +x direction.",
        "Tangential loading in the -z direction.",
        "Oblique loading in direction (1, 0, -1)/sqrt(2)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "relative strengths of multiple load contributions, if present",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "If configuration 1 contains several forces or loaded patches, Sec. 4.1 gives no relative magnitudes. A common overall load scale does not determine these ratios.",
      "readings": [
        "Two load contributions with magnitude ratio 1:1.",
        "Two load contributions with magnitude ratio 2:1.",
        "Two load contributions with magnitude ratio 1:2."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "common amplitude of the configuration 1 loading",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 supplies no numerical force or traction amplitude. Normalizing the reported energy by its intact-cube value does not recover that amplitude.",
      "readings": [
        "Use a reference load amplitude of 1 in consistent units.",
        "Use a reference load amplitude of 2 in the same units."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "support and load attachment material",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1 does not specify protected solid attachment regions or their dimensions. Algorithm 1 provides generic thresholding without explaining how support and load application regions are retained during removal.",
      "readings": [
        "No protected solid voxels; every voxel is eligible for removal.",
        "Protect one voxel layer at the fixed face and the voxels incident on the load application regions.",
        "Protect two-voxel-thick support and load attachment regions."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "topological-derivative threshold parameter C",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 gives only a typical range, C=0.001 to 0.1, and Sec. 5 states that the result strongly depends on C. Sec. 4.1 never supplies its value; the stated three iterations and target volume fraction do not determine it.",
      "readings": [
        "C=0.001.",
        "C=0.01.",
        "C=0.05.",
        "C=0.1."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "isolated-voxel and disconnected-component cleanup",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 requires post-processing that excludes isolated voxels, but does not define isolation, connectivity, or whether larger detached components are also removed.",
      "readings": [
        "Remove only individual voxels having no solid face-sharing neighbor.",
        "Remove individual voxels having no solid neighbor under 26-neighbor connectivity.",
        "Remove every component disconnected from the fixed face under 6-neighbor connectivity.",
        "Remove every component disconnected from the fixed face under 26-neighbor connectivity."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "surface-irregularity cleanup during optimization",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2.3 says surface irregularities are excluded after thresholding, but supplies no voxel operation, neighborhood criterion, or number of cleanup passes.",
      "readings": [
        "One deletion pass removing solid voxels with at most one solid face-sharing neighbor.",
        "One deletion pass removing solid voxels with at most two solid face-sharing neighbors.",
        "Repeat the at-most-two-neighbors deletion rule until no further voxels are removed."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "elasticity-solve convergence tolerance",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 specifies a GMRES tolerance of 1e-4 for its uniform-tension benchmark. Sec. 4.1 reports 100–200 iterations without specifying the cantilever tolerance, its residual convention, or whether the benchmark setting is inherited.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop at relative residual 1e-4.",
        "Stop at absolute residual 1e-4.",
        "Stop at relative residual 1e-6."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Laplacian smoothing of the configuration 1 surface",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 4.1, Fig. 2(C), and Sec. 5 mention Laplacian smoothing without specifying weights, relaxation, pass count, attachment constraints, or volume preservation. They also do not establish whether the smoothed geometry is reanalyzed or used only for presentation.",
      "readings": [
        "Presentation only: one uniform-weight Laplacian pass with relaxation 0.1 and attachment vertices fixed.",
        "Reanalyzed final geometry: ten uniform-weight passes with relaxation 0.5, attachment vertices fixed, and no volume restoration.",
        "Reanalyzed final geometry: ten passes with relaxation 0.5, attachment vertices fixed, and restoration of the pre-smoothing volume."
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
